Repair
How to change a bike tyre
  1. Remove the wheel from the bike
  2. Deflate, and use tyre levers to pry the edge off
  3. Remove the old tube and check for debris
  4. Insert a new, partially inflated tube
  5. Push the tyre bead back onto the rim
  6. Pump up the tyre and reinstall the wheel
